Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. Expect the road to run about 200 hours at a gentle 4/10 difficulty, all offline and all in one playthrough: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the side and activity trophies. PowerPyx's estimate; the tracker on this page shows exactly what is still missing.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play Gone Fishing, the Chapter 1 opener, to its end and it unlocks as the mission closes. No preparation needed — just follow the mission as the game presents it.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish Chapter 1; note it only triggers once the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, is done, so play one mission past the chapter card and it will land.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish Chapter 2; it arrives after the opening mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, so keep going one mission into the next chapter.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4 — Ocean Beach, then Another Life.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish Chapter 4; it comes with the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero, which is also the last story mission in the game.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Unmissable gold story trophy. Complete the final mission, Starting From Zero, at the end of Chapter 4. Once the credits roll you are back in free-roam, so anything still missing for the platinum can be chased afterwards.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 main mission, to the end. Follow the pink mission markers; it unlocks when the mission does.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission. Just play through the chapter and it will come.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 main mission. It arrives naturally as you work through the chapter.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission. Play through the chapter and it unlocks at the mission's end.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 main mission. It comes with normal story progress.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete Operation Savage Glory, the Chapter 5 mission. Play the final chapter and it unlocks as the mission ends.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold, and the longest grind in the set. The checklist appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and anything you did during the story already counts toward it. It is much softer than true 100% — about three-fifths of the game: any 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, plus every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest, and any 100 optional missions. None of it can be missed, and all of it can be done in free-roam after the credits.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver. Finish any 250 of Leonida's 397 stunts: 130 ramp jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps, mixed however you like. Under-the-bridge runs are the fastest to rack up. Watch the count by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so you will clear 250 on the way there.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each of the nine activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, winning a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race, and pulling off a stunt. Your count sits under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. The story and the other trophies cover most of them, so this one usually unlocks without you chasing it.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver. Take gold in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 range locations. The medals are not punishing, and range time also raises your Focus level, which pays off for Gunslinger. Clear them range by range; the range menu tracks your medals.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 races exist, but one win per location is enough. The races also count toward the 100% checklist, so treat them as part of that sweep rather than a detour.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Forty distinct race locations exist, so choose the ones you like and skip the rest. Each location only counts once, so keep moving to fresh spots instead of re-running a win.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal at fishing. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet him, Cal texts you a fishing challenge marked purple on the map, west of Key Lento. Head to the spot and out-fish him. A short quest that opens once he messages you.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Four exist, listed in-game as Video Games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home from Chapter 1, plus Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines around Leonida. Clearing every level of any one of them is enough — you do not have to finish all of its internal challenges. Pick the one you enjoy.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia only. Andy's chain starts by itself in Chapter 3: playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her Belville home address. Work through her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy lands after the last one. The quests stay open after the story.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's chain starts by itself in Chapter 1, some time after the mission Island Dreams, when he calls; he shows as the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving: purple chest markers appear on the map, you dive down, use the metal detector to dig the treasure off the ocean floor and bring it back. Clear all 7 shipwrecks. Kenton falls silent after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3 — as Jason, calling Brian moves things along — so nothing here can be missed. Follow it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's chain starts by itself after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Finish his five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy lands after the last one. Everything stays open after the story.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver. Finish 8 stranger strands across Leonida. Only certain chains count: confirmed so far are Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (the street races, Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 among them) and Pilot Pete (his delivery runs). Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. The strands stay open in free-roam after the story, and the trophy list itself tracks how many you have finished.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's chain, Randy's Wish List, starts by itself after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars brought to his garage, shown by the green RK icon in west Vice City. The list lives under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; he marks some cars for you, and you can also lift them off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app to check whether it is wanted, then bring it back in good shape for better pay. Sports cars are thickest in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. It all stays open after the story.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason only. Tyrone's chain starts by itself after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers for Synthetic Labs show up in Vice City. Head to the labs and destroy them in Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are gone, Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, and finishing it unlocks the trophy. Everything stays open after the story.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations across Leonida; meditating with Jason and Lucia together at a spot counts as +2. The count lives under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The danger is Chapter 1, at Jason's house: after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating in the kitchen in the morning, steps out to the balcony, and you have to follow her, talk to her and pick Accept. That meditation is gone once Chapter 1 closes, and PowerPyx's author only earned the trophy after doing it — so do it while you can, even though it is not proven that it is required. The final meditation needs both characters together, unlocked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of 18.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason only. Bret Vogel's chain starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Run that first quest and Bret starts marking hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animal he asks for and bring it to him as Jason. The first quest hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, which you can pick up again from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. A clean one-shot kill keeps the animal pristine and pays better, but it is not required. Follow the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck — 15 decks, and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy arrives naturally along the way.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver. Finish 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; PowerPyx lists 18 card-set locations. Take the sets one at a time and keep track of the ones you have finished — a set only counts once every card in it is found.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver. Use WAiNK It at 100 places: hold up on the d-pad and R1 to scan things in the world. There are far more than 100 out there — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher Tags among them — so any 100 will do. Scan as you travel and the count fills itself.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants any 70 of 80, so this one lands on the way. The count sits under Progress > Challenges, with a Completed tick on each finished one. Most complete themselves while you chase the other trophies; leave the hardest for last and skip them, since 10 more than needed exist.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Open once Jason and Lucia can free-roam together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Call your partner (hold right on the d-pad, then triangle), build a 4-star wanted level, then get out of the red heat zone — the trophy fires when you drive clear of it, not just out of the flashing search area. A fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic is the easiest escape; shoot down a chasing helicopter if one shows. A solid route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters have trouble following. It can also happen on its own in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault robberies always bring a 4-star wanted level.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Open once you can play with your partner, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. With your partner at your side, rob 3 shops one after another while holding on to your wanted level the whole time — the red/blue flashing level, not the red heat level. Pack an armored vest, sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing, and call your partner (hold right, then triangle). A good run is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: take a couple of items in each, crack the safe with sticky bombs, and do not walk out of the first store before the police show up or it may not register. The unlock comes about half a minute late after you leave the third shop; if it never fires, hit a fourth shop and carry on.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. There are 557 in the game at launch, and you only have to scan them, not drive them: open the WAiNK app (hold up on the d-pad), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. The totals sit under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this one lands on the way.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Trigger it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows, weak spots light up, and the purple focus bar at the top left drains. Top the bar up first with food, drinks or a wash and shower at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, then triangle) to stretch the window. Line up five enemies — gang members at gang operations work well — and take them down fast with an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556. It does not seem to register against soldiers, police or civilians, so choose gang enemies. Focus has four levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; at Focus level 4 it gets far easier, and it often unlocks by itself.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the big passenger planes parked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — one joined to a passenger boarding bridge, not the planes sitting out on the airfield. The simplest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, walk to the plane and use the stairs by the boarding bridge to climb in. Go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane onto the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) clear of the airport. The unlock runs a little late, so keep flying until it lands.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank. They sit at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, parked in the south of the air base. Drive in through the gate, or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and start shooting enemies until the trophy fires.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being spotted. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies, marked with green icons in unfogged areas. Slip in through the back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door sets off the alarm — then find the safe code on a note in the back room, empty the safe, destroy the security footage and switch off the alarm. A good target is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. The trophy fires a little after you walk out of the store.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver. Rob 5 bank vaults and get away. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to carry the briefcase inside and open the vault, then go in and rob it — bring your partner and hold right to pass off a bag, since you cannot carry it all alone. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip about security vans (finish his earlier Payday Loans jobs first); the vans show up purple — follow one to its bank. Robbing a vault instantly brings a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and swap vehicles to go unrecognized. Eight large bank jobs exist in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this one lands on the way; a vault can pay up to $205,000.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away. The same Chapter 4 mission that opens bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is…, counts on its own: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing the truck. You can also get it sooner: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks, so block one's path, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Either way, the trophy only fires once you escape the red heat radius.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — clear the fog off the whole map. The quickest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the map is fully visible. It is a pure exploration trophy, so chip away at it between other goals instead of doing it in one sitting.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. Thirty-nine illegal gang operations exist in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so this one lands on the way. Operations show as yellow icons when you get close, and many are marked on their own from story progress. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and order an Apple Martini. Drink it standing next to the bar, looking out at the view, and the trophy fires.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Only that blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III — and the unlock runs a little late, landing after you drive further down the street.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It is marked on its own during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation to crack the safe. Inside, take the luxury watch from the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 from the table in the north-east corner, and empty the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy fires after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. You do not need all three in one visit: if the robbery icon comes back later you can return for the rest, so it is not missable.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time. The level sits under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia, scrolling to Strength (heart icon). You can only begin after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a fitness club membership and always train together — call your partner (hold right, then triangle) so the other character trains at the same time and you gain twice as fast. Fitness clubs are all over Vice City (filter the map by Activities, dumbbell icon), and you can also train at home after the story.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that shape your criminal profile. Tap the trophy in the trophy list to see your count, and switch on notifications under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile, so a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action registers. Profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives and clean getaways), Hardened (putting people down without killing them), Violent, Psycho, and Irredeemable — the last one is permanent and makes the cops far more aggressive, so stay clear of it. It mostly fills itself through robberies and fights; if it is your last trophy, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: In the prologue Lucia robs a Payday Loans store. Come back later and rob that same store again as Lucia, then leave on foot. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. Go to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City, alone as Lucia without Jason, aim at the teller just like in the prologue, take the money and run — on foot, not in a vehicle — until the trophy fires. The unlock runs late, so keep running.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Finish the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside; if it is not there, drive off and come back. Next to the car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Walk toward it and it drops a woman it took — talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy. The spawn is a little random, so it may take a few tries.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: On any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square inside 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City or Ocean Beach are the easiest places to find ten people close together. Keep riding and kicking until the counter reaches ten inside the minute.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the best. The $250,000 is cumulative across every robbery, not one delivery. It comes naturally while robbing for the 100% checklist; one bank vault can hold up to $205,000.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The quickest way is the pricey stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — buy what you actually want and the total climbs on its own.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, $160,000 in total. They open up after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app shows up on your phone — buy them through the app. The 4 story-related garages do not count. Robberies are the fastest way to make the money, above all the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Buy enough garages first — each one adds parking spots for more registrations — then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
